note: Short-phrase dictionary for the reading tool. English definitions/examples checked against Free Dictionary API and Wiktionary; verb patterns like 'forget to do' are grammar constructions, not dictionary entries, so their glosses are standard textbook meanings. Grows over time: scripts/discover_phrases.py screens article text for new dictionary-listed phrases; reviewed entries are appended here.

items.en: to not remember to do something that you should do
items.ex: Don't forget to do your homework.

items.en: to not remember that you did something
items.ex: I forgot meeting her before.

items.en: to not forget to do something
items.ex: Remember to do your homework.

items.en: to have a memory of doing something
items.ex: I remember seeing this film before.
items.exZh: 我记得以前看过这部电影。

items.en: to continue doing something
items.ex: Keep trying, and you will succeed.

items.en: to no longer do something
items.ex: Please stop talking.

items.en: to stop what you are doing in order to do something else
items.ex: He stopped to talk with an old friend.
items.exZh: 他停下来和一位老朋友聊了几句。

items.en: to make a choice to do something
items.ex: She decided to study abroad.

items.en: to intend to do something
items.ex: We plan to visit Beijing next year.

items.en: to want something to happen or to be true
items.ex: I hope to see you again soon.

items.en: to say yes to doing something
items.ex: He agreed to help us.

items.en: to say no to doing something
items.ex: She refused to answer the question.

items.en: to succeed in doing something difficult
items.ex: He managed to finish the work on time.
items.exZh: 他设法按时完成了工作。

items.en: to not succeed in doing something
items.ex: He failed to pass the exam.

items.en: to gain the skill to do something
items.ex: Children learn to read at school.
items.exZh: 孩子们在学校学会阅读。

items.zh: 设法做某事；努力做某事
items.en: to attempt to do something
items.ex: Try to arrive on time.

items.zh: 试着做某事（换个方法试试）
items.en: to do something as an experiment, to see if it works
items.ex: If you can't sleep, try reading a book.
items.exZh: 如果你睡不着，试试看书。

items.en: to wish to do something
items.ex: I want to learn English.

items.en: to have to do something; to require doing something
items.ex: You need to eat more vegetables.

items.en: must; to be obliged to do something
items.ex: I have to do my homework now.

items.en: Related to or relevant to; concerned with. Used directly after the verb have or have got.
items.ex: As I recall, his book had to do with alien abductions.

items.en: to begin to do something
items.ex: It started to rain.

items.en: to begin doing something
items.ex: She started learning the piano at six.

items.en: to start to do something
items.ex: He began to feel tired.

items.en: to get pleasure from doing something
items.ex: I enjoy reading in the evening.

items.en: to find doing something pleasant
items.ex: She likes swimming in summer.

items.en: to like doing something very much
items.ex: I love listening to music.

items.en: to dislike doing something very much
items.ex: I hate waiting in line.

items.en: to be annoyed or worried by doing something
items.ex: Do you mind opening the window?

items.en: to do something repeatedly to improve
items.ex: Practice speaking English every day.

items.en: to keep away from doing something
items.ex: Avoid eating too much sugar.

items.en: to complete doing something
items.ex: Have you finished reading the book?

items.en: to say that someone should do something
items.ex: I suggest going by train.

items.en: to stop doing something, especially something you have done for a long time
items.ex: He gave up smoking last year.

items.en: to continue doing something
items.ex: Go on reading, please.

items.en: To be familiar with or accustomed to something or someone through repeated experience; to be acclimated to.
items.ex: I'm used to this climate.

items.en: To become accustomed to something; to acclimate; to adjust.
items.ex: I'm getting used to this climate.

items.en: to do something regularly in the past, but not now
items.ex: I used to play football when I was young.

items.en: To anticipate, expect, or wait for, especially with a feeling of approval or pleasure. To be excited or eager to.
items.ex: I look forward to seeing you.

items.en: to want to know or learn about something
items.ex: She is interested in music.

items.en: to be skilled at doing something
items.ex: He is good at maths.

items.en: to feel fear of something
items.ex: She is afraid of dogs.

items.en: Can, to have the ability to.
items.ex: I am able to swim.

items.en: to be prepared to do something
items.ex: Are you ready to go?

items.en: to be occupied with doing something
items.ex: She is busy preparing dinner.

items.en: to be good or important enough to do
items.ex: This book is worth reading.

items.en: to use time doing something
items.ex: He spends a lot of time playing games.

items.en: to enjoy doing something
items.ex: We had fun playing football.
items.exZh: 我们踢足球玩得很开心。

items.en: to want to do something (a polite way to say 'want')
items.ex: I would like to visit London.

items.en: to assist someone to do something
items.ex: Can you help me to carry this box?
items.exZh: 你能帮我搬一下这个箱子吗？

items.en: to join in an activity
items.ex: Many students took part in the sports meeting.
items.exZh: 很多学生参加了运动会。

items.en: To look after, to provide care for.
items.ex: My elderly mother needs to be taken care of.

items.en: to listen to or watch something carefully
items.ex: Pay attention to your teacher.

items.en: To ensure; to take care that something happens.
items.ex: I'm going to make sure that I get to the interview on time.

items.en: To decide.
items.ex: You need to make a decision whether or not to go.

items.en: At the same instant.
items.ex: Their departures were at the same time.

items.en: Eventually, finally.
items.ex: We had a great day at the beach and in the end we had ice cream.

items.en: Initially; at the start; originally.
items.ex: If at first you don't succeed, try, try again.

items.en: After a long time; eventually.
items.ex: Now that the dog has stopped barking, perhaps we can at last get some rest.

items.en: actually; in reality
items.ex: People think he's rich, but in fact he's nearly penniless.

items.en: As an example.
items.ex: For example, I like apples and bananas.
items.exZh: 例如，我喜欢苹果和香蕉。

items.en: to perform an action
items.ex: Let's do something fun today.
items.exZh: 今天我们做点有趣的事吧。

items.en: to perform an action (used after verbs like want, need, decide)
items.ex: She wants to do something special.

items.en: To transform into; become.
items.ex: The carriage turned into a pumpkin at midnight.

items.en: To mature and become an adult.
items.ex: What do you want to be when you grow up?

items.en: To happen, to occur.
items.ex: The planned meeting never took place.

items.en: To discover, as by asking or investigating.
items.ex: Please find out when the train leaves.
items.exZh: 请查一下火车什么时候开。

items.en: To search for; to seek.
items.ex: He spent his life looking for the truth.

items.en: To observe or watch.
items.ex: Look at the blackboard, please.

items.en: to speak about something; to discuss
items.ex: Let's talk about your plan.

items.en: To ponder.
items.ex: I've been thinking about human rights since watching that documentary.

items.en: to feel troubled about something
items.ex: Don't worry about the exam.

items.en: to gain knowledge by studying or experiencing something
items.ex: We can learn from our mistakes.
items.exZh: 我们可以从错误中吸取教训。

items.en: To have as one's birthplace or nationality.
items.ex: Where do you come from?

items.en: To reach (a destination)
items.ex: We arrived at the station at nine.

items.en: to reach a large place, such as a city or country
items.ex: They arrived in London yesterday.

items.en: to prepare for something
items.ex: Get ready for school!

items.en: In front of; before.
items.ex: A hill loomed ahead of them.
items.exZh: 一座小山出现在他们面前。

items.en: To be true; to be the situation.
items.ex: If that is the case, we need a new plan.
items.exZh: 如果情况是这样，我们需要一个新计划。

items.en: To easily go past a limit or target.
items.ex: I've just blown past my calorie limit for the day.
items.exZh: 我今天的卡路里摄入一下子就超标了。

items.en: To cause something to fall; to defeat or remove from power.
items.ex: The rebel forces are trying to bring down the president.
items.exZh: 反叛军正试图推翻总统。

items.en: To fetch something back; to return with something.
items.ex: Could you bring me back some chocolate?
items.exZh: 你能给我带回一些巧克力吗？

items.en: When a future event has happened.
items.ex: I'll be an old man by the time you finish!
items.exZh: 等你做完，我都成老头子了！

items.en: To look after someone; to like something.
items.ex: I cared for my ailing mother for five years.
items.exZh: 我照顾了生病的母亲五年。

items.en: To bring down by cutting; to reduce.
items.ex: They want to cut down several trees to make room for the parking lot.
items.exZh: 他们想砍掉几棵树来建停车场。

items.en: A long way from; not at all.
items.ex: Don't leave now: our task is far from complete!
items.exZh: 现在别走：我们的任务还远没有完成！

items.en: To want to do something; to seem like.
items.ex: I didn't feel like working yesterday, so I called in sick.
items.exZh: 我昨天不想工作，所以请了病假。

items.en: To leave a place; (of a light or fire) to stop burning.
items.ex: Please go out through the back door.

items.en: To move upwards; to increase.
items.ex: There are new offices going up in town.
items.exZh: 镇上正在建新的办公楼。

items.en: As a means of achieving something; to.
items.ex: In order to be fit, you've gotta train hard every day.
items.exZh: 为了保持健康，你必须每天刻苦训练。

items.en: In development; in the process of being made.
items.ex: You're witnessing a great reference work in the making.
items.exZh: 你正在见证一部伟大的参考著作的诞生。

items.en: In place of; rather than.
items.ex: He walked to school instead of taking the car.
items.exZh: 他走路去上学，而不是坐车。

items.en: A type of; slightly, somewhat.
items.ex: I'm getting kind of tired. Could we finish tomorrow?
items.exZh: 我有点累了，明天再做完行吗？

items.en: To confuse two things.
items.ex: He often mixes up two similar words.
items.exZh: 他常常混淆两个相似的词。

items.en: To use something in a playful or experimental way.
items.ex: The children like to play with the new toy.
items.exZh: 孩子们喜欢玩这个新玩具。

items.en: To put a lot of money or effort into something.
items.ex: They poured a lot of money into the project.
items.exZh: 他们往这个项目里投了很多钱。

items.en: To offer something for sale; to place something up.
items.ex: The painting was put up for auction.

items.en: To bring about; to lead to.
items.ex: The protests resulted in widespread unrest.
items.exZh: 抗议导致了广泛的动乱。

items.en: To explain something in detail; to start a journey.
items.ex: This contract sets out all the terms of the agreement.
items.exZh: 这份合同详细列出了协议的所有条款。

items.en: To go more slowly.
items.ex: When approaching a bend in the road, slow down.

items.en: To result; to end up being.
items.ex: I had hoped our first meeting would turn out better.
items.exZh: 我本希望我们的第一次见面能更好一些。

items.en: Higher than a previous value; increased from.
items.ex: The unemployment rate is 4.2%, up from 3.8% last quarter.
items.exZh: 失业率是 4.2%，高于上季度的 3.8%。

items.en: To walk along or down something.
items.ex: You can walk down a narrow lane and hear only your own steps.
items.exZh: 你可以沿着一条小巷走下去，只听见自己的脚步声。

items.en: to have something as a goal or target
items.ex: The summit is aimed at reaching new agreements on food trade rules.
items.exZh: 这次峰会旨在就食品贸易规则达成新协议。

items.en: in many different places all over the world
items.ex: Grand Theft Auto fans around the world pulled all-nighters to play the new game.
items.exZh: 全球《侠盗猎车手》的粉丝们熬通宵玩这款新游戏。

items.en: to stay away from school or work without permission
items.ex: Students bunked off school to play the new game.
items.exZh: 学生们逃课去玩新游戏。

items.en: to finally be in a particular place or situation
items.ex: What started as a small problem ended up being a medical emergency.
items.exZh: 起初的一个小问题最终变成了一场医疗紧急情况。

items.en: to go into something by falling
items.ex: The hat fell into the hippo's enclosure.
items.exZh: 帽子掉进了河马的围栏里。

items.en: to come from a particular place
items.ex: Jones hails from the Wrexham area in north-east Wales.
items.exZh: 琼斯来自威尔士东北部的雷克瑟姆地区。

items.en: approximately; close to a particular figure
items.ex: Fiona weighed in the region of 2,500lb.
items.exZh: 菲奥娜体重大约 2500 磅。

items.en: to go through a place or thing
items.ex: Veterinarians tried to help the hat pass through her system.
items.exZh: 兽医们试图帮助帽子从她的体内排出来。

items.en: to block something so it cannot get through
items.ex: A gravitational signal cannot simply be screened out by ordinary material.
items.exZh: 引力信号无法简单地被普通材料屏蔽掉。

items.en: to put something in place so it is ready for use
items.ex: The gravimeter was set up on the floor of a men's bathroom.
items.exZh: 重力仪被安放在男洗手间的地板上。

items.en: to increase or improve something
items.ex: He has stepped up efforts to appeal to younger voters.
items.exZh: 他加大了争取年轻选民的力度。

items.en: to leave or abandon a deal or situation
items.ex: The UK could walk away from the deal on Friday.
items.exZh: 英国可能在周五退出这项协议。
